asr.full_text: What does financial freedom mean to you? According to an article posted by Investopedia in October of 2019 it states their financial freedom generally means having enough savings investments and cash in hand to afford the lifestyle that we want for ourselves and our families and Growing a nest egg that will allow us to retire or pursue a career that we want Without being driven by any earnings of a certain amount each year for me financial freedom just means doing doing what I want, when I want, and with who I want, which of course are those that I love and care dearly for. Yeah the house, vacations, cars and toys are all great, don't get me wrong I don't wanna sound crazy but what I'm saying is that the material things mean nothing without the loved ones there to share it with. Your definition may be a bit different than mine but one things for certain financial freedom is necessary in order to live the life of our dreams here's how we achieve financial freedom and how you can too first let's discuss what mti is not mti is not a get rich quick program it's a real opportunity that anyone anywhere can benefit from with patience and trust it's not a hype program also, also known as a high yield income program. There are no guarantees, we don't control the market nor do we control the price of bitcoin. And lastly, it's definitely not a scam. All earnings are paid from the trading profits. If the system doesn't profit, there will be no earnings. Now let me tell you what MTI is. MTI is a Forex company that uses sophisticated trading software to grow Bigfoot MTI is based data Johannesburg South Africa and launched April 2019 since launching has averaged over 12 percent growth for mom MT is a vehicle anyone anywhere can achieve financial freedom and where 100% of members win. Let me share with you our personal results We joined MTI September 16, 2019 Our one account was traded in total 56 trading days Our account achieved over 28 percent growth and for the first time in our career 100 percent and the MTI members everyone that we brought into this program with us have grown their accounts as well we are all winning here are some real testimonials from some of our team members people from all over the world have been winning with MTI. As you can clearly see everyone wins with MTI. You may be thinking this sounds good but where's the proof? Well here's some proof. Our initial investment was $2,200.00 worth of bitcoin on september 16 2019 and last week we made our first three withdrawals for over nine thousand dollars worth of bitcoin all three withdrawals hit our account in under 12 hours from requesting our funds. Everyone wins with MTI, and you can too. Here, let me show you. With MTI, even a $100 investment can potentially be life changing. Here's a compound interest calculator. With a $100 investment, earning just 5% monthly and compounding daily, you see potential growth of 82.12% growing your account to over $182 after 12 months. Now after 10 years of the same 5% growth and daily compounding interest, you can increase your account over 40,000%. Yes. That's 40,000% potential growth on a $100 investment without doing anything and letting the MTI system work for you. So where will you be one year from now? For 10 years from now? We know where we'll be. We'll be here with MTI where everyone wins

It cites reported investment and withdrawal amounts and associates a $100 investment with "40,000% potential growth" without action. The speaker says there are no guarantees, and the reported results and projections are unverified.
